name: tower_lit_at_sunrise
about: The rising sun lights a (morning light on the face you see): the sun is behind you, within 30 deg of straight behind, and a is in view. Its must (a at bearing 195-15 deg, the only side a sunrise-lit face can be on) drops points before any skyline is traced, so use it as a must. For briefs like 'morning light on the tower (lab: sunrise-lit-tower)'
